people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.
translations.bsb: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
translations.kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
translations.asv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
